name: Custom Web Applications
tagline: Tailor-made software for your exact workflow — CRMs, booking systems, dashboards, portals, and fast MVPs.

hero.headline: Replace Manual Processes with Custom Business Software
hero.subhead: From full custom-built platforms to fast no-code MVPs — software built around how your business actually works.

description: Off-the-shelf software rarely fits perfectly. I build web-based applications for your specific workflow — CRMs, booking systems, inventory tools, client portals, admin panels, and internal dashboards — using modern, scalable technology (Next.js, Supabase). For faster MVPs and SaaS products, I also build on Bubble.io, letting you validate an idea and launch in weeks instead of months.
problems: Spreadsheets and disconnected tools are slowing your business down
You need a booking system, CRM, or inventory tracker that fits your exact process
You have a software idea but don't want to spend months (or a fortune) building it
Your team needs one internal tool instead of five different apps
deliverables: Live web application on your domain or subdomain
CRM, booking system, dashboard, inventory tracker, client portal, or admin panel — scoped to your workflow
User authentication and role-based access (admin, staff, customer)
Source code (GitHub repository) and admin credentials
User manual and a training session
Bubble.io builds: full ownership transfer to your own account
features: Full-stack custom development for complex, long-term systems
Bubble.io no-code builds for fast MVPs and SaaS validation
Learning management systems and membership portals
Data migration from spreadsheets or legacy systems
Scalable architecture that grows as your business does

process.detail: A detailed session to map your workflow, user roles, and must-have features — in writing before work starts.
Database architecture and screen flows planned before any code is written.
Full-stack development (or a Bubble.io build for faster MVPs) with regular check-ins.
Real-world scenario testing and bug fixes before launch.
Live deployment, admin handover, and a training session for your team.

faqs.question: How is this different from buying off-the-shelf software?
faqs.answer: Generic tools like Shopify or generic CRMs have features you don't need and lack ones specific to your business. Custom software fits your exact workflow, reducing friction and training time.

faqs.question: Should I go custom-built or Bubble.io?
faqs.answer: If you need to validate an idea fast or launch an MVP in weeks, Bubble.io is usually the smarter path. For long-term, highly custom, or high-scale systems, full custom development is the better investment.

faqs.question: Can I add features later?
faqs.answer: Yes. Systems are built with scalability in mind — additional features are scoped and priced after the initial build.

faqs.question: Is my data secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Custom builds use Supabase/PostgreSQL with row-level security and proper authentication. Bubble builds run on Bubble's production-grade infrastructure.
